== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Tatooine: Jawa Camp (Japanese Premiere Two-Player)|Tatooine: Jawa Camp]] from [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.categoryonegames.com/catalog/star_wars_ccg-swccg_premiere_sw_2pg_japanese/tatooine_jawa_camp__lightside_japanese_white_border/50611 CategoryOneGames], [https://cc-client-assets.cdn.crystalcommerce.com/photo/categoryonegames/file/7a6e35035de0475ca17d7cd6bbf4e949/IMG_20220607_0137.jpg source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(8, 6, 1060, 770)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>4a64e1d30f8f94e9b690c402d7416b3b4fc78025d0c869541da2f3535f126606</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
